sources.text: Synthetic unaudited management accounts for August 2027, delivered September 15, 2027. Year-to-date revenue was $66.9 million, against $66.2 million in the origination base case. Subscription billing remained invoiced annually in advance. Receivables were collected in 43 days on average, compared with 42 days at origination. Cash was $15.2 million at August 31, and restricted cash was unchanged at $1.5 million. Funded term debt was $78.0 million; the next scheduled principal installment is due December 31, 2027.

Management calculates trailing-four-quarter Covenant EBITDA of $22.0 million through June 30, 2027 with no restructuring adjustment, and Total Net Leverage of 3.09x on net debt of $68.0 million after netting $10.0 million of Eligible Cash, against the 4.05x maximum. This is a management calculation in monthly accounts. It is not a Compliance Certificate and has not been reviewed by the auditor. The next quarterly test date is September 30, 2027.
